lookback_notes: The pages for D0150 do not state an assessor observation/look-back window in days for this item. The interview questions themselves use a 2-week symptom-recall period ("Over the last 2 weeks, have you been bothered by any of the following problems?" — p. D-3), and D0100 notes that the resident interview "is conducted during the look-back period of the Assessment Reference Date (ARD)" without stating the number of days (p. D-2). A 7-day look-back is stated only for the staff assessment D0500 (p. D-13), not for D0150. Therefore lookback_days is NOT_FOUND.

conflicts.topic: Coexisting time windows for D0150: assessor look-back period of the ARD vs. the 2-week symptom-recall period used in the interview questions

positions.claim: The resident mood interview is conducted during the look-back period of the Assessment Reference Date (ARD); the number of days is not stated for D0150.

source.quote: This interview is conducted during the look-back period of the Assessment Reference Date (ARD) and is not contingent upon item B0700, Makes Self Understood.

positions.claim: Symptom presence and frequency are rated against the resident's recall of the last 2 weeks.

source.quote: Code 0, never or 1 day: if the resident indicates that during the past 2 weeks they have never been bothered by the symptom or have only been bothered by the symptom on 1 day.

conflicts.resolution: unresolved — surface to user; the 2-week window is the symptom-recall period inside the interview questions, while the assessor look-back window in days is not stated on the D0150 pages.
